title: Embervale
description: Pick a class. Cast spells. Become a legend! Embervale is a D&D-inspired survival world where you choose a class, wield magic, and rise as a Wayfarer.
body:
## Embervale SMP ![Embers of the Deep](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/19e1defb592fd5a6fb7a3127133dfa8fa7785691.png) 🎥 [Embervale - Embers of the Deep | Season 2 Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hsPwAJmPAXg) A modded survival server with proximity chat set in the world of Embervale, where **Wayfarers** become adventurers, roleplayers, explorers, and builders carving out a home of their own. D&D meets Minecraft. Choose a class, learn spells, join a faction, build a town, and take part in a living, multi-season story that grows with every chapter. The world rewards those who take their time, explore, and find their own adventure. Choose your class and forge your path: **
• Bard
• Wizard (Ice, Fire, Arcane)
• Warrior
• Rogue
• Paladin
• Priest
• Archer**
• _More classes arriving every season or version!_ --- ## Now Sailing Toward Season 3: Where the Tide Brought Us _Version 3.0.0 coming in August!_
Trade ships have appeared from far-off lands. Salt-worn strangers with no homeland have come to make Embervale their home. The black market has found us. Season 3 brings: - ⛵ Sailable ships. Crew them, arm them with cannons, and sail past the reef - 🐋 Giant whale ships drifting through the sky - 💰 A full player economy with a five-tier coin system and a black market - 🗡️ New classes: the Witcher, plus Bountyhunter, Tundra, and War Archers - 🎨 Painting. Craft a canvas, paint what you see, and hang it across the world - 🧸 Plushies, new sea life, new decor, and more - 🌍 The border expands another 1,000 blocks to 13k by 13k --- ## Current Modpack/Live Server Details - 🗡️ **Difficulty:** Hard - 📦 **350+ Mods** optimized for performance - ⚔️ PvP enabled - 🎉 Party system - 🌑 **New Dimension:** Deeper Dark - 🧙 **Class system** with 5 tiers per class - 🌿 Skill trees for classes and weapons - 🗺️ Waystone fast travel - 🌍 12,000 x 12,000 block world (_expanding each season_) - 🔥 Fire tick disabled - ⚡ Immediate respawn enabled - 🪦 Player bodies persist for 30 minutes with full inventory - 🌙 40% of players sleeping skips the night --- ## Links - 👉 [Apply here to join](https://discord.gg/D3HFdrFQXt), and approval covers both our **Discord** and the **live Embervale SMP server**. - 💛 [Donations if you love Embervale!](https://ko-fi.com/superloafbear) - 💬 Reach out to me on Discord: **loafboy** - 🎥 [YouTube](https://youtube.com/@LoafCentral)
